classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish the circular face, curved surface and total exposed surface of a solid hemisphere.

content.prompt: For the solid hemisphere shown, find:

spec.description: Solid hemisphere with its circular flat face uppermost, shown as a complete ellipse. The curved silhouette extends below it. A centre dot and horizontal radius to the right rim carry the given 8 cm label. Ordinary source colours are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Hemisphere radius 8 cm; flat face area pi r squared; curved area half the surface area of a sphere.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given radius is visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: the area of the flat surface

children.label: b
children.prompt: the surface area of the curved part of the hemisphere

answer.worked:
The curved surface is half the surface of a sphere.

$\begin{aligned}A_{\text{curved}}&=\frac12\times4\pi r^2\\A_{\text{curved}}&=2\pi\times8^2\\A_{\text{curved}}&=128\pi\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{curved}}&\approx402.12\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$

children.label: c
children.prompt: the total surface area of the solid hemisphere

answer.worked:
Include the flat face and the curved surface.

$\begin{aligned}S&=64\pi+128\pi\\S&=192\pi\text{ cm}^2\\S&\approx603.19\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$
